strict_future_epoch_slices.description: Scores ONLY holdout epochs t_ho > T_seal_end that occurred in physical wall-clock time strictly after the last training window's holdout ended (zero epoch overlap).

full_weight_band_h_le_5400s.description: Subset of strict-future epochs inside the unity-taper band (h <= 5400 s), where the sealed ridge correction carries full weight; isolates future-epoch ridge skill from the tapered tail.

tapered_tail_h_gt_5400s.description: Subset of strict-future epochs inside the down-taper region (h > 5400 s), where dep blends back toward stack_unc linearly reaching zero ridge weight at 9,900 s; measures the causal stack baseline mixed with the down-weighted sealed ridge.

embargo_7200s_2h_disjoint.description: Full 2-hour holdout purge gap (Delta_T >= 7,200 s) with zero weight updates across the 2-hour embargo.

fixed_position_late_band_h4500_5400_by_l.description: Same h in [4500,5400] s slice (unity taper, late holdout) scored at every seal lead: isolates weight staleness against lead at fixed epoch position, removing the taper-tail confound of the strict-future slices.

resubstitution_bound.description: Each seal's frozen weights scored on its own newest member window's holdout (pure in-sample resubstitution). Bounds the shared-epoch channel: if walk-forward skill met or exceeded this bound, the headline would be a resubstitution artefact; observing OOS >= resubstitution bounds the echo below the deployed-cadence skill.

clean_origin_fit_half.description: Zero-overlap ex-ante arm: member Grams built on the FULL 2-hour fit half [t_pre[0], t_pre[-1]] of each member — epochs ending strictly before that member's own holdout, hence before EVERY scored evaluation holdout — with the member's own persist level as target anchor. No scored holdout epoch ever entered any member's training target at ANY seal lead — the shared-epoch channel is eliminated by construction. Basis is the causal network block (sta_* station curves plus the sid_* sidereal-echo and wv_* wave-composite fields, evaluated on a station-only dictionary so no holdout-shaped negative-h features exist). The deployed-style composite (stack_unc baseline), a pure-correction arm (persistence baseline), and a per-feature diagonal combiner are reported separately so the map's own transfer is isolated from baseline choice. The strict-future slice is reported for completeness even though the whole holdout is already disjoint.

map_stability_disjoint_seal_cosine.description: Cosine similarity between weight vectors of seals k_tr apart, whose exponential-decay member weights share <0.02% of Gram mass — i.e. trained on effectively disjoint target epochs. A stable spatial field map yields cosine >> 0; per-realisation noise weights decorrelate.
map_stability_disjoint_seal_cosine.note: Weight-space cosines understate map stability in this collinear multi-resolution basis; the prediction-space cosines (same eval feature matrix, disjoint-seal weight vectors) are the operative stability diagnostic.

lambda_robustness_pure.description: Clean-origin seals re-solved on a fixed lambda grid via eigendecomposition (the deployed lam was tuned on holdout Grams; the forward arm may need stronger shrinkage). All grid values reported; pure-correction scoring, no eval-data selection.

inner_cv_lambda_selection.description: Fully ex-ante per-seal lambda selection: argmin of J(w)=w'Gv w + 2w'gv evaluated on the newest member's holdout Gram (inner_ho; disjoint from every fit-half target, and an operationally available validation set at deploy time — its target epochs overlap the eval holdout, mirroring live tuning), on the pooled holdout Gram of the WHOLE sealed ring (inner_pool; the complete holdout-regime validation set an operator holds at seal time and the quantity the deployed lam was tuned on), on the newest member's fit Gram (inner_fit; in-domain reference), and on the newest member's fit Gram under a ring solved without it (inner_lno; leave-newest-out — disjoint train/validation, the CV most faithful to the forward task).  lam is fixed before the eval window is scored — no eval data enters the choice.
inner_cv_lambda_selection.inner_lno_note: Leave-newest-out validation: ring solved without the newest member's fit Gram and each candidate lam scored on exactly that held-out Gram — the inner CV most faithful to the forward task; all data pre-seal.
